account.login.browser_code: Your browser is open. Check this code there:
account.login.intro: Sign in to access meetings across your devices and use Pennel Cloud without your own API key.
account.logout.title: Sign out?
account.logout.unconfirmed: You have not confirmed your recovery code yet. You will need it to recover your meetings after signing out. Sign out anyway?
account.sync.title: Sync meetings
account.sync.privacy: End-to-end encrypted: Pennel Cloud cannot read your meetings. Audio stays on this device.
account.sync.confirm_deletes_detail: Pennel will also delete these meetings in Pennel Cloud and on your other devices. They stay in each device’s trash for 30 days.
account.recovery.title: Recovery code
account.recovery.description: Keep this recovery code. You need it to enable sync on another device. Without the code or a signed-in device, nobody can read your cloud data, including us.
account.recovery.vault_reset: The vault was reset on another device. Enter the new recovery code.
account.recovery.lost_detail: Without the recovery code, nobody can read your meetings in Pennel Cloud. You can reset the vault.
account.recovery.reset_detail: This deletes all meetings in Pennel Cloud. Meetings on your devices stay in place and will be uploaded again. Other devices will need the new recovery code.
account.recovery.unconfirmed: You have not confirmed your recovery code yet.
account.recovery.new_detail: The old recovery code will no longer work.
account.devices.title: Devices
account.devices.name: Device name
account.devices.revoke_detail: This device will no longer be able to sync. Existing files stay on it. If you think it was stolen, reset the vault.
account.delete.title: Delete account
account.delete.detail: Your account and all encrypted data in Pennel Cloud will be deleted. Meetings on this device stay in place.
account.claude.title: Claude access
account.claude.help: Let Claude search and summarize your meetings. Claude sends questions to this computer, which answers from the meetings stored here. Your meetings in Pennel Cloud remain end-to-end encrypted. Works while Pennel is open on this computer.
account.claude.connector_help: In claude.ai: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, using this URL:
account.claude.sign_in_help: Claude will then ask you to sign in to Pennel once.
account.claude.connected: Connected. Claude can search your meetings on this computer.
account.claude.error: Cannot connect to Pennel Cloud. Pennel will try again shortly.
